verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions are its automation primitive, triggered by events, webhooks, and schedules. The docs say functions can deploy automatically from source control, which gives Git-based versioning of automation code. Nothing in the pack documents review or approval for function deployments, and nothing documents rolling back to a prior deployment; the branch preview links apply to Sites, not Functions. Missing for 10: documented review/approval flow for function deployments, documented rollback to previous function deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
